GARAGE_GATE.NAME: Garage / Gate
GARAGE_GATE.DESCRIPTION: Motor control of a garage door or gate with one or two buttons, end switches and a light barrier

TOGGLE.NAME: Toggle (Tg)
TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: open, stop, close, stop - for single button control

COMPLETE_OPEN.NAME: Complete open (Co)
COMPLETE_OPEN.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: opens completely, stopping is not possible

COMPLETE_CLOSE.NAME: Complete close (Cc)
COMPLETE_CLOSE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: closes completely, stopping is not possible

PARTIAL_OPEN.NAME: Partially open (Po)
PARTIAL_OPEN.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: moves to the partial open position

LOCK.NAME: Off / lock (Off)
LOCK.DESCRIPTION: 1: stops and locks the block, 0: unlocks it

DISABLE_PERIPHERY.NAME: Disable periphery (DisPc)
DISABLE_PERIPHERY.DESCRIPTION: 1: ignores Tg, Op, Cl, Co, Cc, Po and Stop from links (child lock); the visualization and the central still work

OBSTACLE.NAME: Obstacle / light barrier
OBSTACLE.DESCRIPTION: 1 while closing: stops and opens again; closing is blocked while 1

CENTRAL.NAME: Central command
CENTRAL.DESCRIPTION: Link the command output of a Garage / Gate Central (1 open, 2 close, 3 stop, 4 partially open); ignores DisPc

PULSE.NAME: Motor pulse (Qi)
PULSE.DESCRIPTION: Pulses for a motor with one button input (motor control: single button)

STATE.NAME: State
STATE.DESCRIPTION: 0 closed, 1 open, 2 partially open, 3 opening, 4 closing

IS_OPEN.NAME: Open
IS_OPEN.DESCRIPTION: 1 when the door is not fully closed

TYPE.NAME: Type
TYPE.DESCRIPTION: Garage door or gate, changes the animation in the visualization

MOTOR_MODE.NAME: Motor control
MOTOR_MODE.DESCRIPTION: Two outputs (open / close) or one pulse output for a drive with a single button input (open, stop, close, stop)

OPEN_TIME.NAME: Opening time (s)
OPEN_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Time from closed to fully open

CLOSE_TIME.NAME: Closing time (s)
CLOSE_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Time from fully open to closed

PARTIAL_POSITION.NAME: Partial open position (%)
PARTIAL_POSITION.DESCRIPTION: Position for Po, e.g. to let a pedestrian or a pet through

PULSE_LENGTH.NAME: Pulse length (ms)
PULSE_LENGTH.DESCRIPTION: Length of a pulse at the motor pulse output (Qi)

AUTO_CLOSE.NAME: Close automatically after (s)
AUTO_CLOSE.DESCRIPTION: Closes the door this long after it reached fully open, 0 = off

GARAGE_CENTRAL.NAME: Garage / Gate Central
GARAGE_CENTRAL.DESCRIPTION: Controls several Garage / Gate blocks together and counts the open and closed doors

TOGGLE.NAME: Toggle (Tg)
TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: stops all doors when one moves, otherwise closes all when one is open, otherwise opens all

PARTIAL_OPEN.NAME: Partially open (Po)
PARTIAL_OPEN.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: moves all doors to their partial open position

LOCK.NAME: Off / lock (Off)
LOCK.DESCRIPTION: 1: stops all doors and locks the central, 0: unlocks it

DISABLE_PERIPHERY.NAME: Disable periphery (DisPc)
DISABLE_PERIPHERY.DESCRIPTION: 1: ignores Tg, Co, Cc, Po and Stop from links (child lock)

STATE1.NAME: State door 1
STATE1.DESCRIPTION: Link the State output of a Garage / Gate block

STATE2.NAME: State door 2
STATE2.DESCRIPTION: Link the State output of a Garage / Gate block

STATE3.NAME: State door 3
STATE3.DESCRIPTION: Link the State output of a Garage / Gate block

STATE4.NAME: State door 4
STATE4.DESCRIPTION: Link the State output of a Garage / Gate block

STATE5.NAME: State door 5
STATE5.DESCRIPTION: Link the State output of a Garage / Gate block

STATE6.NAME: State door 6
STATE6.DESCRIPTION: Link the State output of a Garage / Gate block

STATE7.NAME: State door 7
STATE7.DESCRIPTION: Link the State output of a Garage / Gate block

STATE8.NAME: State door 8
STATE8.DESCRIPTION: Link the State output of a Garage / Gate block

COMMAND.NAME: Command
COMMAND.DESCRIPTION: Link to the Central command input of every Garage / Gate block (1 open, 2 close, 3 stop, 4 partially open)

OPEN_COUNT.NAME: Open doors (No)
OPEN_COUNT.DESCRIPTION: Number of doors that are not closed

WINDOW_CENTRAL.NAME: Window Central
WINDOW_CENTRAL.DESCRIPTION: Central control of several motorised windows (window actuators or shutter blocks), weather protection and counters

TOGGLE.NAME: Toggle (Tg)
TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: open, stop, close, stop - for single button control

POSITION.NAME: Position (Pos)
POSITION.DESCRIPTION: Moves all windows to this opening in % (0 closed, 100 open)

SLIGHTLY_OPEN.NAME: Slightly open (So)
SLIGHTLY_OPEN.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: moves all windows to the slightly open position

WEATHER_PROTECTION.NAME: Weather protection (Wp)
WEATHER_PROTECTION.DESCRIPTION: 1: closes all windows and locks them (rain, wind), 0: releases them

LOCK.NAME: Off / lock (Off)
LOCK.DESCRIPTION: 1: stops all windows and locks the central, 0: unlocks it

WINDOW_POSITION1.NAME: Position window 1
WINDOW_POSITION1.DESCRIPTION: Opening of window 1 in % (0 closed, 100 open), for the counters

WINDOW_POSITION2.NAME: Position window 2
WINDOW_POSITION2.DESCRIPTION: Opening of window 2 in % (0 closed, 100 open), for the counters

WINDOW_POSITION3.NAME: Position window 3
WINDOW_POSITION3.DESCRIPTION: Opening of window 3 in % (0 closed, 100 open), for the counters

WINDOW_POSITION4.NAME: Position window 4
WINDOW_POSITION4.DESCRIPTION: Opening of window 4 in % (0 closed, 100 open), for the counters

WINDOW_POSITION5.NAME: Position window 5
WINDOW_POSITION5.DESCRIPTION: Opening of window 5 in % (0 closed, 100 open), for the counters

WINDOW_POSITION6.NAME: Position window 6
WINDOW_POSITION6.DESCRIPTION: Opening of window 6 in % (0 closed, 100 open), for the counters

WINDOW_POSITION7.NAME: Position window 7
WINDOW_POSITION7.DESCRIPTION: Opening of window 7 in % (0 closed, 100 open), for the counters

WINDOW_POSITION8.NAME: Position window 8
WINDOW_POSITION8.DESCRIPTION: Opening of window 8 in % (0 closed, 100 open), for the counters

OPEN.NAME: Open
OPEN.DESCRIPTION: Sends 1 for every open command (link to the open / up input of the windows)

POSITION.NAME: Position
POSITION.DESCRIPTION: Target opening in % for actuators with a position input (0 closed, 100 open)

LOCKED.NAME: Locked
LOCKED.DESCRIPTION: 1 while weather protection or Off is active (link to the lock input of the windows)

OPEN_COUNT.NAME: Open windows (No)
OPEN_COUNT.DESCRIPTION: Number of windows with an opening above 0 %

MEDIA_CONTROLLER_MODE.NAME: Media Controller Mode
MEDIA_CONTROLLER_MODE.DESCRIPTION: One per device of a media controller: passes on only the commands of its mode (link the command output of the media controller)

COMMAND.NAME: Command
COMMAND.DESCRIPTION: Command output of the media controller

MODE.NAME: Mode
MODE.DESCRIPTION: Mode of the media controller (1-8) this device belongs to

POWER.NAME: Power
POWER.DESCRIPTION: 1 while this mode is on (switch the device on with it)

MEDIA_PLAYER.NAME: Media player
MEDIA_PLAYER.DESCRIPTION: A music zone, speaker or TV of any driver as a control: Matter, HomeKit and voice assistants can play, pause and set the volume

PLAYING.NAME: Playing
PLAYING.DESCRIPTION: State of the device: 1 while it plays

MUTE.NAME: Muted
MUTE.DESCRIPTION: State of the device: 1 while muted

TITLE.NAME: Title
TITLE.DESCRIPTION: State of the device: the current title

ARTIST.NAME: Artist
ARTIST.DESCRIPTION: State of the device: the current artist

BRIDGE_TYPE.NAME: Smart home type
BRIDGE_TYPE.DESCRIPTION: How Matter shows the player. On/off with volume: on plays, off pauses, the level is the volume; every voice assistant can control it. Speaker: the Matter speaker type (on/off mutes), only Google Home shows it

MEDIA_CONTROLLER.NAME: Media Controller
MEDIA_CONTROLLER.DESCRIPTION: Universal remote: up to 8 modes (e.g. TV, radio) with power, volume, channel, number pad, navigation and playback commands

POWER_TOGGLE.NAME: Power toggle (Ptg)
POWER_TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: switches the current mode on or off

POWER_ON.NAME: Power on (Pon)
POWER_ON.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: switches the last mode on

POWER_OFF.NAME: Power off (Poff)
POWER_OFF.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: switches the current mode off

VOLUME_UP.NAME: Volume + (V+)
VOLUME_UP.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: volume up, switches the last mode on when off

DIGIT.NAME: Number pad digit
DIGIT.DESCRIPTION: Digit 0-9; the channel is sent after the number pad timeout

MODE.NAME: Mode
MODE.DESCRIPTION: Activates the mode with this number (1-8), 0 switches off

LOCK.NAME: Off / lock (Off)
LOCK.DESCRIPTION: 1: switches off and locks the block, 0: unlocks it

DISABLE_PERIPHERY.NAME: Disable periphery (DisPc)
DISABLE_PERIPHERY.DESCRIPTION: 1: ignores the command inputs from links (child lock); the visualization still works

COMMAND.NAME: Command (to the mode blocks)
COMMAND.DESCRIPTION: Every command as "mode:command[:value]", link it to the "Media Controller Mode" block of each device

MODE.NAME: Current mode (M)
MODE.DESCRIPTION: Number of the active mode, 0 = off

MODE_ACTIVE1.NAME: Mode 1 active
MODE_ACTIVE1.DESCRIPTION: 1 while mode 1 is active (switch the devices of this mode on with it)

MODE_ACTIVE2.NAME: Mode 2 active
MODE_ACTIVE2.DESCRIPTION: 1 while mode 2 is active (switch the devices of this mode on with it)

MODE_ACTIVE3.NAME: Mode 3 active
MODE_ACTIVE3.DESCRIPTION: 1 while mode 3 is active (switch the devices of this mode on with it)

MODE_ACTIVE4.NAME: Mode 4 active
MODE_ACTIVE4.DESCRIPTION: 1 while mode 4 is active (switch the devices of this mode on with it)

MODE_ACTIVE5.NAME: Mode 5 active
MODE_ACTIVE5.DESCRIPTION: 1 while mode 5 is active (switch the devices of this mode on with it)

MODE_ACTIVE6.NAME: Mode 6 active
MODE_ACTIVE6.DESCRIPTION: 1 while mode 6 is active (switch the devices of this mode on with it)

MODE_ACTIVE7.NAME: Mode 7 active
MODE_ACTIVE7.DESCRIPTION: 1 while mode 7 is active (switch the devices of this mode on with it)

MODE_ACTIVE8.NAME: Mode 8 active
MODE_ACTIVE8.DESCRIPTION: 1 while mode 8 is active (switch the devices of this mode on with it)

VOLUME_UP.NAME: Volume +
VOLUME_UP.DESCRIPTION: Sends 1 for every volume up command

VOLUME_DOWN.NAME: Volume -
VOLUME_DOWN.DESCRIPTION: Sends 1 for every volume down command

CHANNEL_UP.NAME: Channel +
CHANNEL_UP.DESCRIPTION: Sends 1 for every channel up command

CHANNEL_DOWN.NAME: Channel -
CHANNEL_DOWN.DESCRIPTION: Sends 1 for every channel down command

MODE_NAME1.NAME: Name of mode 1
MODE_NAME1.DESCRIPTION: Shown in the visualization, empty = mode not used

MODE_NAME2.NAME: Name of mode 2
MODE_NAME2.DESCRIPTION: Shown in the visualization, empty = mode not used

MODE_NAME3.NAME: Name of mode 3
MODE_NAME3.DESCRIPTION: Shown in the visualization, empty = mode not used

MODE_NAME4.NAME: Name of mode 4
MODE_NAME4.DESCRIPTION: Shown in the visualization, empty = mode not used

MODE_NAME5.NAME: Name of mode 5
MODE_NAME5.DESCRIPTION: Shown in the visualization, empty = mode not used

MODE_NAME6.NAME: Name of mode 6
MODE_NAME6.DESCRIPTION: Shown in the visualization, empty = mode not used

MODE_NAME7.NAME: Name of mode 7
MODE_NAME7.DESCRIPTION: Shown in the visualization, empty = mode not used

MODE_NAME8.NAME: Name of mode 8
MODE_NAME8.DESCRIPTION: Shown in the visualization, empty = mode not used

NUMPAD_TIMEOUT.NAME: Number pad timeout (ms)
NUMPAD_TIMEOUT.DESCRIPTION: Time after the last digit before the channel is sent (Nst)

IRRIGATION.NAME: Irrigation
IRRIGATION.DESCRIPTION: Waters up to 8 zones one after the other with a pump; skips or shortens a run after rain or when rain is forecast

ACTIVATE.NAME: Activate (Act)
ACTIVATE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: starts a run unless there was enough rain in the last 24 hours or enough rain is forecast

START.NAME: Start now
START.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: starts a run in any case (like the visualization)

STOP.NAME: Stop
STOP.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: stops the run, the pump and all valves

SELECT.NAME: Select valve (Sel)
SELECT.DESCRIPTION: 1-8 waters only this zone, 9 opens all valves, 0 stops

RAIN_FORECAST.NAME: Rain forecast (Raf)
RAIN_FORECAST.DESCRIPTION: Expected precipitation in the next hours in mm (l/m²), e.g. from OpenWeatherMap

RAIN.NAME: Rain (Ra)
RAIN.DESCRIPTION: 1 while it rains (rain sensor), used for the rain time of the last 24 hours

LOCK.NAME: Off / lock (Off)
LOCK.DESCRIPTION: 1: stops and locks the block, 0: unlocks it

ACTIVE_VALVE.NAME: Active valve (Av)
ACTIVE_VALVE.DESCRIPTION: 0 all off, 1-8 the active zone, 9 all on

RUNNING.NAME: Running
RUNNING.DESCRIPTION: 1 while a run or a selected valve is active

REMAINING.NAME: Remaining time (s)
REMAINING.DESCRIPTION: Remaining time of the active zone

SKIPPED.NAME: Skipped
SKIPPED.DESCRIPTION: 1 when the last activation was skipped because of rain

RAIN_TIME.NAME: Rain time 24 h (s)
RAIN_TIME.DESCRIPTION: How long it rained in the last 24 hours

MAX_RAIN_FORECAST.NAME: Maximum rain forecast (MaxR, mm)
MAX_RAIN_FORECAST.DESCRIPTION: Act does not start when the rain forecast is above this value

MAX_RAIN_TIME.NAME: Maximum rain time (MaxRa, s)
MAX_RAIN_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Act does not start when it rained longer than this in the last 24 hours

ADJUST_BY_RAIN.NAME: Shorten by rain
ADJUST_BY_RAIN.DESCRIPTION: Shortens the zone times by the share of the rain forecast and rain time in their limits (e.g. half the limit = half the time)

SCHEDULE.NAME: Schedule
SCHEDULE.DESCRIPTION: Start time and weekdays for an automatic activation (like Act); the stop time is not used

ZONE_NAMES.NAME: Zone names
ZONE_NAMES.DESCRIPTION: Names of the zones for the visualization, separated by ;

DURATION1.NAME: Time zone 1 (Tv1, s)
DURATION1.DESCRIPTION: How long zone 1 is watered, 0 = zone not used

DURATION2.NAME: Time zone 2 (Tv2, s)
DURATION2.DESCRIPTION: How long zone 2 is watered, 0 = zone not used

DURATION3.NAME: Time zone 3 (Tv3, s)
DURATION3.DESCRIPTION: How long zone 3 is watered, 0 = zone not used

DURATION4.NAME: Time zone 4 (Tv4, s)
DURATION4.DESCRIPTION: How long zone 4 is watered, 0 = zone not used

DURATION5.NAME: Time zone 5 (Tv5, s)
DURATION5.DESCRIPTION: How long zone 5 is watered, 0 = zone not used

DURATION6.NAME: Time zone 6 (Tv6, s)
DURATION6.DESCRIPTION: How long zone 6 is watered, 0 = zone not used

DURATION7.NAME: Time zone 7 (Tv7, s)
DURATION7.DESCRIPTION: How long zone 7 is watered, 0 = zone not used

DURATION8.NAME: Time zone 8 (Tv8, s)
DURATION8.DESCRIPTION: How long zone 8 is watered, 0 = zone not used

SCENE.NAME: Scene
SCENE.DESCRIPTION: Starts a scene (an action list without conditions) from an input or from a button in the visualization. The actions are an automation with the trigger 'Scene is activated'.

ACTIVATE.DESCRIPTION: Activate: every value other than 0 starts the scene

OFF.DESCRIPTION: Off: while 1 the scene is locked and cannot be started

ACTIVATED.DESCRIPTION: Pulse (1 for 0.5 s) when the scene is started

TYPE.NAME: Type
TYPE.DESCRIPTION: Form of the gauge (linear or circular)

SLAT.NAME: Slat position
SLAT.DESCRIPTION: Slat position feedback of the actuator in percent (0 horizontal, 100 closed)

SLAT.NAME: Slat position
SLAT.DESCRIPTION: Slat position in percent (0 horizontal, 100 closed)

ENERGY_MANAGER.NAME: Energy manager
ENERGY_MANAGER.DESCRIPTION: Uses the PV surplus: switches up to 12 loads on and off by priority, with hysteresis, delays and minimum on/off times. Analog loads get a power setpoint.

GRID.DESCRIPTION: Grid power in kW: + import, - export (see "Invert grid")

SURPLUS.DESCRIPTION: Surplus in kW (+ = surplus), measured with the managed loads running. Used instead of the grid power

BATTERY.DESCRIPTION: Battery power in kW: + charging, - discharging. At or above the minimum SoC the charging power is used for loads

MANUAL.DESCRIPTION: 1 = load on at full power (manual), outside the manager's budget

LOCK.DESCRIPTION: 1 = load off and locked (wins over manual)

AVAILABLE.DESCRIPTION: Power in kW available for the managed loads (surplus - reserve + their own power)

ALLOCATED.DESCRIPTION: Power in kW of the loads the manager runs

SETPOINT.DESCRIPTION: Power setpoint in kW (analog loads between switch-on and max power, 0 = off)

INVERT_GRID.NAME: Invert grid
INVERT_GRID.DESCRIPTION: On: positive grid power means export

RESERVE.NAME: Reserve (kW)
RESERVE.DESCRIPTION: Power kept as a buffer, never given to loads

HYSTERESIS.NAME: Hysteresis (kW)
HYSTERESIS.DESCRIPTION: A load switches on with switch-on power + hysteresis spare, loads are shed when the import exceeds the hysteresis

ON_DELAY.NAME: Switch-on delay (s)
ON_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: How long the surplus must last before a load switches on, also the time between two switch-ons

OFF_DELAY.NAME: Switch-off delay (s)
OFF_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: How long the import must last before loads are shed

MODULATION_INTERVAL.NAME: Modulation interval (s)
MODULATION_INTERVAL.DESCRIPTION: Analog setpoints rise at most once per interval, they drop at once

MIN_SOC.NAME: Minimum battery SoC (%)
MIN_SOC.DESCRIPTION: Below this SoC the battery charges first and no load is switched on

ON_POWER.DESCRIPTION: Power of the load in kW (analog loads: minimum power). 0 = load not used

MAX_POWER.DESCRIPTION: Maximum power in kW (analog loads only)

TYPE.DESCRIPTION: Digital: on/off. Analog: on/off and a power setpoint

LOAD_MANAGER.NAME: Load manager
LOAD_MANAGER.DESCRIPTION: Overload protection: locks up to 8 loads by priority while the total power is above max power, and releases them again with a delay.

STATUS.DESCRIPTION: Load status: 1 = running, 0 = idle (idle loads are not shed). Unlinked = running

OVERLOAD.DESCRIPTION: 1 while the total power is above max power

RESERVE.DESCRIPTION: Power in kW left until max power (negative = overload)

MAX_POWER.NAME: Max power (kW)
MAX_POWER.DESCRIPTION: Maximum total power, can be linked

HYSTERESIS.NAME: Hysteresis (kW)
HYSTERESIS.DESCRIPTION: A load is released only if the total power plus its power stays this far below max power

SHED_DELAY.NAME: Shed delay (s)
SHED_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: How long an overload must last before loads are locked

RELEASE_DELAY.NAME: Release delay (s)
RELEASE_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: How long the power must stay low enough before the next load is released

POWER.DESCRIPTION: Power of the load in kW. 0 = load not used

ENABLE.NAME: Presence simulation (PS)
ENABLE.DESCRIPTION: 1 enables the presence simulation (e.g. linked to an 'away' flag); 0 stops it and switches off once

MODE.NAME: Presence simulation mode
MODE.DESCRIPTION: Off: not used in the presence simulation. Random: a random number of activations of random length inside the window. Replay: switches as it was switched by hand one week ago (random when nothing was recorded then)

WINDOW.NAME: Presence simulation time
WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: Days and time window in which the presence simulation may switch

MIN_ACTIVATIONS.NAME: Min. activations
MIN_ACTIVATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Minimum number of times the output is switched on per window

MAX_ACTIVATIONS.NAME: Max. activations
MAX_ACTIVATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of times the output is switched on per window

MIN_DURATION.NAME: Min. duration [min]
MIN_DURATION.DESCRIPTION: Minimum duration of one activation in minutes

MAX_DURATION.NAME: Max. duration [min]
MAX_DURATION.DESCRIPTION: Maximum duration of one activation in minutes
